Registration Deadline

About IBM Bob

IBM Bob is an AI-powered development partner designed to help developers work with real systems, not just code snippets.


It operates with full repository context, allowing developers to understand how software is structured, reason through logic, and navigate complex codebases more effectively.


Bob supports practical development tasks and helps builders at any skill level move from idea to implementation with greater clarity and confidence.


This hackathon is your chance to apply Bob in a real project and see how it fits into your workflow.

Challenge
Challenge

In this hackathon, you will design and build a proof-of-concept solution using IBM Bob, your AI-powered development partner, to address the following challenge:

Turn idea into impact faster

Got an idea for how to work smarter and faster? Create a solution that speeds the way you work every day.


Maybe you need to:

• Get up to speed on existing code quickly

• Generate documentation and tests

• Reduce effort spent on repetitive tasks that slow your team down


Use IBM Bob as your development partner to bring your idea to life.


Bob understands intent, reads complete repository context, explains logic with clarity, automates complex transformations, and streamlines multi-step work.


Show how your solution, powered by Bob, can help builders at any skill level deliver high-quality software with greater efficiency and confidence.


Important:

All submissions must clearly demonstrate how IBM Bob is used in the solution. 

Projects that do not show meaningful use of Bob may be disqualified.  

Technology

IBM Bob is an AI-powered development partner that works directly with your codebase, helping you build and improve software with real context.

It is designed to support developers across everyday workflows, allowing you to apply AI within your own project rather than working in isolation.

⚠️ Public GitHub Repository & IBM Bob Report

Judging Criteria
Application of Technology
How complete and well thought-out the project is, with a clear application of IBM Bob.
Presentation
The clarity and effectiveness of the project presentation. 
Business Value
The impact and practical value, considering how effectively the solution addresses a high priority issue.
Originality
The uniqueness and creativity of the solution and the approach in applying IBM Bob to address the stated issue.

Hackathon Details

Join lablab.ai hackathon and innovate using the latest models in the market. Discover all the relevant details below.

🗓️ Where and when

The hackathon is fully online starting on May 15th till May 17th, 2026. The hackathon will take place on the lablab.ai platform and lablab.ai Discord server. 

🦸🏼‍♂️ Who can join?

We welcome participants with a strong interest in AI. While prior experience can be helpful, this challenge is designed for those ready to engage with AI in meaningful and practical ways. 

😅 What about teams?

If you don't have a team, don't worry! You can connect with other participants from all over the world on our dashboard or Discord server. We also recommend checking out our Discord server to find teammates and bounce around ideas. You can join the server here.

🛠️ How to participate

The hackathon will take place online on lablab.ai platform and lablab.ai Discord Server. Please register for both in order to participate. To participate click the "Sign up" button at the bottom of the page and read our Hackathon Guidelines and Getting Started Guide.

🧠 Get prepared / Use Lablab.ai to Learn About AI

To get ready for the hackathon, visit our AI Tech pages and read up on all the available technologies. You can also check out our tutorials page for more information on how to use them. Get a head start on your project by using the resources on lablab.ai!
